messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv_cache_eviction_rate spike on prod-gpu-pool-3 at 12:02 UTC — 95th latency > 1200ms, eviction_count increased x8 in 3m. Aggregated metric: kv_size_per_session median rose from 20KB -> 240KB. Tagging #oncall

alice: seeing same in traces. correlated with recent awq-7b-int8 kernel rollout 02:45 UTC. kernel selector bumped to `awq_int8_v2` across pool-3.

maria: confirmed. model telemetry shows per-token kv growth for awq-7b-int8 when sequence > 1024 — KV entries not being compacted due to new kv-encoding change in kernel.

sre-oncall: is customer impact reported? any 5xx spikes?

cs-liz: yes — Support ticket 23456 from AcmeCorp: intermittent 502s during long chat sessions, started ~03:00 UTC. They're on Dedicated node pool-3.

alice: stacks: continuous-batching + prefix-KV caching. root cause hypothesis: int8 kernel uses a different KV layout and our cache-size heuristics didn't account for the larger serialized footprint => cache blowup + eviction storm + backpressure on batch queues.

ops-bot: live log snippet from pool-3: 
```
[12:04:02] kv_cache: entries=1.2M, total_bytes=289MB
[12:04:05] eviction: count=1240, policy=LRU
[12:04:07] batch_queue: inflight=256, avg_batch_ms=230
[12:04:09] model-awq-7b-int8 kernel=awq_int8_v2 selected_by=auto
```

tony: immediate impact plan (short window mitigation):
- throttle continuous-batch max inflight and reduce max_tokens per batch
- pin awq-7b on pool-3 to fp16 fallback variant while we triage int8 footprint
- increase per-tenant kv cap (soft limit) to prevent single session blowups
- notify customers with possible degraded tails

maria: pushing hotpatch for batch config: reducing continuous_batch.max_tokens from 1024 -> 256 and inflight from 256 -> 64. also set `kv_cache.max_entry_bytes_per_session=50kb`. patch applied to pool-3 staging, rolling to prod now. command: 
```
rictl apply -f - <<EOF
{ "pool":"pool-3", "continuous_batch": { "max_tokens":256, "max_inflight":64 }, "kv_cache": { "max_entry_bytes_per_session":"50kb" } }
EOF
```

alice: also initiating model variant rollback: 
```
rictl model rollback --pool pool-3 --model awq-7b --to-variant awq-7b-fp16-fallback --reason "kv-blowup-int8-2026-03-15"
```

sre-oncall: taking over remediation. I'm going to monitor eviction rate and 95p latency. tagging @pager-duty. I will update every 5m.

(5m later)

sre-oncall: update 12:12 UTC — hotpatch rolled to 3/3 nodes in pool-3. eviction_rate down ~70%. 95th latency improved from 1200ms -> 420ms. batch inflight reduced to 60-70. no new 502s observed in last 6m.

cs-liz: AcmeCorp reports much better behavior. still seeing a couple of long tail responses for very long sessions (>5k tokens) — advising them to reconnect sessions if they see degraded perf.

alice: next steps for medium-term (hours):
- reproduce in staging with synthetic long-session generator to confirm serializer difference
- add kv serialized-size histogram to model telemetry for all quant kernels
- add kernel-selector guard: if estimated_kv_size_per_token > threshold fallback to fp16 or alternate kernel
- create emergency regression test for cont-batch + kv footprint across quant variants

maria: I already spun up a regression job. failing case reproduced with awq_int8_v2: kv_ser_size/token ~ 6x fp16 when using attention-optimizer flags. adding PR to runtime to correct serializer packing.

ops-bot: metric deltas: 
- kv_cache_total_bytes: 289MB -> 86MB (post-patch)
- eviction_count/min: 420 -> 130
- 95p_latency: 1.2s -> 0.42s
- 5xx_rate: 0.9% -> 0.1%

tony: longer-term (postmortem) items:
- revert awq_int8_v2 rollout until serializer fix and telemetry in place
- tighter release gating for kernel selection changes (include kv footprint sim)
- add continuous-batch adaptive throttling based on eviction pressure
- customer impact comms + RCA timeline for AcmeCorp and 3 other affected customers

sre-oncall: handing off to next shift in 1h. current status: mitigation applied, rollback in place for awq-7b on pool-3, monitoring green but keep alert thresholds lowered for 2 hours.

alice: experimenting with temporary kernel whitelist: only enable awq_int8_v2 on pools with kv_serializer_compat=true. config diff: 
```
{ "kernel_selector": { "awq_int8_v2": { "allowed_pools": ["pool-1","pool-2"], "disallowed_pools": ["pool-3"] } } }
```

cs-liz: drafting customer note: 'We observed increased latency and occasional 502s for long-running sessions due to a kernel rollout that increased KV serialized footprint. We rolled back affected variant and applied batch throttles; service restored. Full RCA and timeline forthcoming.' sending to impacted customers shortly.

maria: creating internal rollback checklist + in-progress PR #4521 for serializer fix and unit tests. I'll link to the regression harness when PR is ready.

(Closing note)

sre-oncall: assigning postmortem owner: alice. Action items captured in incident tracker: INC-2026-0315-A. Will keep thread open until RCA published. If anyone sees fresh regression, ping here and I'll re-open the escalation. :white_check_mark:
